mathematical_observations: The observed mean spacing is very close to the predicted mean spacing based on the Riemann-von Mangoldt formula, suggesting consistency with the local density theory near the height T.

The standard deviation of the observed spacings (1.0102) is significantly larger than the predicted standard deviation for the Gaussian Unitary Ensemble (GUE) spacing distribution (0.422), indicating that the data does not follow the GUE model.
